scope: Complete authentic PhysioNet-MI source preparation under the released direct-200-Hz profile and a fixed-output full-test scorer/comparator software control. This is not trained REVE performance, author-baseline qualification, historical paper reproduction or same-task improvement.

source_execution.identity_basis: The full-panel receipt records the public source revision; the scorer control separately pins panel.py. Independent reviews pin panel.py, metrics.py and author_adapter.py. Adapter source was present but no model initialization or inference was executed.

current_source.relationship_to_execution: panel.py, metrics.py and author_adapter.py retain the execution-source bytes. README.md changed to document the authentic preparation and software control; its changed hash is explicit. No model execution is inherited from the adapter source.

software_controls.prediction_policy: Two separately identified identical constant-class outputs, frozen before derived test targets were opened.

preserved_counterexamples: The first transfer timed out; only checksum-valid completed files were reused before all 654 EDFs verified.
The first preparation process selected an interpreter without MNE and failed before reading data; an explicit existing interpreter resolved the failure.
One final native imagery annotation was too short under the released epoch rule and was recorded as dropped, without padding or participant exclusion.
input_exposure: Operator-only raw public annotations and derived targets; constant-output control frozen before derived targets opened; no candidate or checkpoint selection. The original public source annotations are exposed; operator custody of derived targets does not make them an untouched evaluation population.
limits: The original Table 12 trained downstream classifier checkpoint remains unresolved; an encoder-only checkpoint does not replace it.
Historical 128 Hz intermediate preprocessing versus the released direct 200 Hz recipe remains unresolved despite the complete epoch-count match.
Historical seed/run identities, repeat count and standard-deviation denominator remain unresolved.
No trained author model inference or fitting occurred, and no author baseline, paper reproduction, improvement or current SOTA result is qualified.
A paired candidate comparison, effect/uncertainty rule and protected untrusted-candidate transport remain unqualified.
The independent observed review checked authenticated acquisition/preparation metadata and did not independently rehash raw EEG arrays or inspect targets.
Reported file pins identify execution and reviewed current snapshots; this report does not qualify arbitrary later source changes.
evidence_custody: Original operator protocols, acquisition/preparation metadata, software-control summary and independent reviews remain outside public Git. Only their content identities are published here; no raw recordings, targets or prediction arrays are included.
